defect: narrow source pulse can disappear between destination edges
rationale: The source emits an unacknowledged single-cycle pulse; the slower destination can miss the entire pulse.
author: gpt-6.1-sol

labels.by: claude-opus-5-5 (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: A one-cycle 2 ns pulse sampled by a 23 ns clock is usually missed; it needs a toggle or stretch.
